comments.text: Present odometer reading of my car is around 57000 Km and age of the vehicle is 5 years and 1 month. Could I opt for a policy which offers PAYD?
comments.author: @AbhijnanTalukder

comments.text:
Hi Abhijnan, opting for a Pay As You Drive (PAYD) policy should not be an issue as long as your average annual running is around 12,000 km or below. The current odometer reading and vehicle age do not restrict eligibility on their own; the key factor is your expected yearly usage.

To understand the detailed terms and check suitable PAYD options for your car, we recommend browsing our website here: https://www.policybazaar.com/motor-insurance/car-insurance/pay-as-you-drive-insurance/

Do let us know if you need any assistance while exploring the plans.

comments.text:
Revealing the actual reality of Insurance frauds happening with hard earned money of customer in need. Policy bazaar took no time, like less than 5 mins to process the insurance of my 3 cars. Seeing the customer friendly policies, I too had faith in the company. But all promises shattered when actual time came to execute thier so called "HOLLOW CLAIMS"

My car accident revealed the dark side of these insurance fraudsters. Post accident, numerous calls have been made by me to the Oriental Insurance surveyor for provision of preferred time and for estimate costs. Even after tiresome weeks of seeking help, I didn't get any firm resolution. This was the height of negligence by any established company. This is how they literally take away mental peace of the person who has put his hard earned money and trust on the company. 

When I connected to the Prem motors, they gave me the estimate cost of more than 2.5 lakhs. The surveyor called me to convey that they can consider my case for total loss value of my vehicle HR19N5304. However, if I chose to repair the vehicle, then I will have to bear certain undisclosed amount and adding to this I will have to sign a consent letter before they start the repair work. Like is the new way to loot a customer? How are they defining the *"Zero Depreciation"*? These reflected the low ethics and fragile business policies. 

I had choosen the Policy Bazaar for my 5 vehicle for over 6 long years, thinking that company will firmly abide to its terms. That, post accident, it won't give further trauma by mentally harassing the already pissed and tired customer. Now, they are asking me to pay extra amount after showing me sort of their home-made and non-sense terms and conditions which are absolutely pathetic and non-customer friendly. 

I also inquired the repair cost of my vehicle in outside market which is getting estimated at around 2 lakhs. After this, when asked the surveyor whether I can get my car repair at some other workshop of maruti and can they reimburse that bill. To which, this person again slipped from the customer supporting behaviour and said, in that case the reimbursement amount might change. 

After all these mental toil and ordeal which I have faced after this accident, all I want from these low ethics company is to get my car repaired under Zero Depreciation Insurance where I will only bare the file charges and absolutely NOTHING over this. If you wish I can present all the call records over social media to clear the background picture of claim process.

The trail of mental toil is just ending with Policy bazar. I wonder how this company is even functioning with zero business ethics and without grievances mechanism. The least any organisation can do is to stick on the words and excute as per the terms and conditions. Policy Bazar left no stone unturned in making the situation even worst for the customer like me who always put the faith in them. 

My car had a zero dep. insurance cover from Policy Bazar. Post accident, I actually witnessed thier true colours when show led no urgency in processing my case. After going through alot of back and forth, these sloth bears woke up from their sleep to do thier duty. 

Zero-depreciation car insurance policy offers includes coverage of car parts without any deduction for depreciation, protection against monetary losses due to car damages, and peace of mind during uncertain situations. In simple words, I was not required to pay for the depreciation cost while making a claim. I had opted for Zero dep. Insurance inorder to stay composed in any traumatic situation. But instead of this, it turned out to be worst nightmare for me because of Policy bazar. 

My Insurance coverage amount was 355000 INR which was supposed to be directed for the total loss. Nearly 75 percentage of this amount was to be channelised by Policy bazar. The cap of 230000 was already put before the initiation of repairing work on my car. Because they already know the rules of this game. That is why they take the approval from customer at the initial stage. Now after 2 months since, I'm stated that I need to pay 43000 INR before the delivery of my car. It just blew my mind. I cannot understand how they can levy the depreciation cost on the customer??? I was supposed to pay the file charges only which I wasn't expecting anyway more than 25-30k. This 42000 INR is loot or rather I tag is the incompetency of Policy Bazar that they have reflected while delivering their customer services. I'm forced to say this that accident has caused far less injury to me than your spinless company. 

I urge the higher management at Policy bazar to spare sometime and get your best people (if there are any left), involved to analyse the case. If you cannot get the solid resolution, I see no point in posting such elaborated post for your shame. Better face your customer in the court. May be there you can justify your ill-tactics and comprehend to the fact that how you looted customer's hard earned money.

Sarbvir Singh Charanjeet Nagpal The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd. Policybazaar.com Maruti Suzuki India Limited #PankajTripathi #AkshayKumar #AjayBhatt #help #insurance #cars #trauma #complaints #socialhelp #frustration
